# Isaiah Chapter 45 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 153r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_045_page_001.jpg

---

## Consensus Translation

**45:1** Thus says YHWH to his-anointed [li-meshicho], to-Koresh [Cyrus], whom-I-have-grasped [hechezaqti] by-his-right-hand [bi-ymino] to-subdue [le-rad] before-him nations [goyim], and-the-loins [motnei] of-kings [melakhim] I-will-loose [efatteach]; to-open [liftoach] before-him doors [delatayim] and-gates [u-she'arim] will-not be-shut [lo yissageru]:

**45:7** "I-form [yotser] light [or] and-create [u-vorei] darkness [choshekh]; I-make [oseh] peace [shalom] and-create [u-vorei] evil [ra]; I, YHWH, do [oseh] all these [kol-elleh]."

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah 45 — "Cyrus, God's Anointed" — part of Second Isaiah (chs.40-55). The Babylonian exile and imminent return shape the theological vision of hope and restoration.

---
## Disagreement Log

Minor register disagreements resolved through standard SOPHIA consensus process.

---
